name: PetsFriendly Premium Cat Litter – Yellow Bag
description: Super-absorbent clumping cat litter with odour-lock formula. Made from natural minerals, it traps moisture instantly and keeps the litter box fresh for up to 30 days. Dust-free and safe for all cat breeds.

name: Clumping Cat Litter – Lavender Scent
description: Lavender-scented clumping litter that neutralises bad odours at the source. Forms tight, easy-to-scoop clumps and leaves your home smelling clean. Low-dust formulation, gentle on paws.

name: Ultra Absorbent Cat Litter – Purple Pack
description: High-performance cat litter with triple-layer odour control. The ultra-fine granules clump quickly for easy scooping. Ideal for multi-cat households and long-lasting freshness.

name: Premium Bentonite Cat Litter – Purple
description: Premium bentonite-based clumping litter with superior liquid absorption. Keeps the litter box hygienic and odour-free. Lightweight formula that's gentle on cats' sensitive paws.

name: Cat Litter – Economy Pack
description: Reliable everyday cat litter at an affordable price. Effective clumping action keeps the tray clean and hygienic. A practical choice for budget-conscious pet owners without compromising on quality.

name: Multi-Cat Clumping Litter – Green Pack
description: Specially formulated for homes with multiple cats. Powerful odour-elimination technology combined with fast-clumping granules keeps the tray fresh all day. Low-tracking and easy to clean.

name: Benito Premium Cat Treat Snacks
description: Irresistible bite-sized treats your cat will love. Made with real chicken and tuna, packed with protein and essential vitamins. Perfect as a training reward or an everyday snack. No artificial colours or preservatives.

name: Colourful Cat Food & Water Bowl Set
description: Set of 4 vibrant-coloured feeding bowls in different sizes. Made from food-grade BPA-free plastic, easy to wash, and stackable for storage. Suitable for cats, kittens, and small dogs.

name: Single Deep Cat Food Bowl – Purple
description: Sturdy, deep-set bowl in rich purple. Non-slip base keeps it stable during feeding. Wide opening makes it easy for cats to eat without whisker fatigue. Dishwasher safe.

name: Premium Open Cat Litter Tray – Blue
description: Spacious open-top litter tray with high side walls to prevent litter scatter. Smooth interior surface for easy cleaning. Ideal for adult cats and kittens. Made from durable, odour-resistant plastic.

name: 4-in-1 Black Cat Carrier & Cage Set
description: Versatile 4-in-1 modular cat carrier that converts into an open playpen. Well-ventilated mesh panels keep your cat comfortable during travel. Secure locking system and foldable design for easy storage.

name: Multi-Colour Cat Bowl Collection
description: Set of 6 bright, fun feeding bowls in assorted colours. Each bowl has a non-slip rubber base and a wide rim for comfortable feeding. BPA-free and safe for everyday use.

name: Large Open Cat Litter Box – White & Orange
description: Generously sized open litter tray with a smooth rim for easy gripping. Low entry point makes it accessible for kittens and senior cats. Easy to clean and resistant to staining.

name: Round Colourful Pet Bowls – Set of 5
description: Set of 5 round, deep pet bowls in vivid colours. Suitable for wet and dry food as well as water. Easy to stack and store. Scratch-resistant and dishwasher safe. Great for cats and puppies.

name: Cat Food & Accessories Starter Kit
description: Everything a new cat owner needs in one convenient kit. Includes a food bowl, water bowl, litter scoop, and a starter pack of premium food. A thoughtful gift for anyone bringing home a new kitten.

name: Wooden Cat Climbing Ladder
description: Natural pine wood cat ladder with smooth-sanded rungs. Encourages climbing, stretching, and play to keep your cat active and mentally stimulated. Easy to assemble and lean against walls or furniture.

name: Cat Grooming & Feeding Combo Set
description: All-in-one grooming and feeding accessory combo. Includes a fine-tooth comb, nail clipper, and two feeding bowls. Everything you need to keep your cat well-fed and well-groomed in one handy set.

name: Decorative Bird House – Yellow
description: Bright yellow hanging bird house for budgies, lovebirds, and small parrots. Sturdy plastic frame with a wide opening for easy cleaning. Creates a secure, cosy resting spot inside the cage.

name: Multi-Section Cat Food Bowl – Pastel
description: Divided feeding bowl with separate sections for wet food, dry food, and water. Keeps different foods from mixing. Pastel colours and a non-slip base make mealtimes easy and mess-free.

name: Stackable Neon Cat Bowls – Set of 4
description: A set of 4 neon-coloured stacking bowls in bright green, yellow, pink, and blue. Lightweight yet sturdy. Perfect for feeding multiple cats or separating wet and dry food. Microwave and dishwasher safe.

name: Premium Magenta Cat Bowl – Large
description: Large-capacity feeding bowl in bold magenta. The deep design holds generous portions without spilling. Wide non-slip base keeps it firmly in place. Easy to clean and built to last.

name: Fancy Feast Premium Cat Food
description: Premium wet cat food in a variety of mouth-watering flavours. Made with real meat and fish, enriched with taurine and omega-3 for a healthy coat and sharp eyesight. No artificial additives.

name: Catfood Variety Pack – Kitten & Adult
description: Mixed variety pack containing premium dry and wet food options for kittens and adult cats. Includes different flavours to keep your cat interested at mealtimes. Balanced nutrition for every life stage.

name: Adjustable Dog Harness & Leash Set – Red
description: Comfortable padded dog harness in bold red with matching leash. Adjustable straps fit small to large breeds securely. Reflective stitching for visibility on evening walks. Easy clip-and-go buckle system.

name: NowFit Premium Adult Dog Food
description: High-protein dry dog food formulated for adult dogs of all breeds. Packed with real chicken, essential vitamins, and omega fatty acids for a shiny coat and strong joints. No artificial colours or fillers.

name: AirPro Performance Dog Food
description: Specially formulated for active and working dogs. Rich in lean protein and complex carbohydrates to fuel energy and support muscle recovery. Fortified with vitamins B and E for peak performance.

name: Dog Collar & Leash Set – Assorted Colours
description: Cheerful set of dog collar and matching leash available in multiple vibrant colours. Made from durable nylon with a secure metal buckle. Adjustable for puppies and adult dogs. Great starter set for new pet owners.

name: Multi-Colour Dog Training Leashes – Set of 5
description: Set of 5 colourful dog leashes in red, blue, green, orange, and purple. Strong braided nylon construction with comfortable padded handles. Ideal for training sessions, daily walks, and multi-dog households.

name: Heavy-Duty No-Pull Dog Harness – Red & Black
description: Robust no-pull harness designed for medium to large breeds. Dual attachment points for front and back clipping give you full control on walks. Breathable mesh padding keeps your dog cool and comfortable.

name: Complete Dog Walking Accessories Kit
description: All-in-one walking kit including an adjustable harness, a 1.5 m leash, a retractable lead, and a set of waste bags. Suitable for dogs of all sizes. Everything you need for a safe and enjoyable walk.

name: Colourful Pet Bird – Decorative Figurine
description: Vibrant hand-painted bird figurine, perfect as a cage decoration or a charming shelf display. Crafted from lightweight, durable resin. A delightful gift for bird lovers.

name: Wooden Bird Perch Stand
description: Natural wood perch stand for budgies, cockatiels, and small parrots. Helps maintain healthy beak and nail condition. Easy to attach to most standard bird cages. Safe, non-toxic finish.

name: Bird Cage Hanging Toy – Blue
description: Stimulating hanging toy in vivid blue for parrots and budgies. Features colourful beads, bells, and chewable wooden blocks to keep birds entertained. Easy-clip attachment fits all standard cages.

name: Bird Feeder Bowl – Pink & Yellow
description: Bright clip-on feeder bowl in pink and yellow, suitable for seeds, pellets, and fresh fruit. Securely attaches to cage bars for mess-free feeding. Easy to remove and dishwasher safe.

name: Bird Treat & Seed Feeder – Pink Roof
description: Charming house-shaped feeder with a pink roof for pet birds. Holds a generous amount of seeds and treats. Transparent body lets you monitor food levels at a glance. Suitable for budgies and canaries.

name: Bird Water & Feed Dish Set – Green
description: Set of two clip-on dishes in green — one for water and one for food. Keeps your bird's feeding station tidy and hygienic. Fits standard cage wire spacing. BPA-free and easy to clean.

name: Bird Cage Feeder Cup – Pink
description: Single clip-on feeder cup in pink for small and medium-sized birds. Deep cup design prevents seed spillage. Lightweight and easy to attach or remove without disturbing your bird.

name: Bird Feeding Station – Yellow
description: Bright yellow multi-purpose feeding station for cage birds. Features a wide tray base to catch fallen seeds and two side cups for seed and water. Keeps the cage floor cleaner for longer.

name: Premium Bird Seed & Treat Dispenser
description: Transparent dispenser that keeps seeds fresh and dry while allowing easy access for your bird. Refillable from the top without removing the unit from the cage. Compatible with most cage bar sizes.

name: Bird Cage Hanging Feeder – Yellow
description: Cheerful yellow hanging feeder for budgies and lovebirds. Hook attachment allows flexible positioning inside the cage. Wide opening makes it easy to fill and clean. Holds seeds, millet, and small treats.

name: Bird Cage Cuttlebone & Mineral Block Holder
description: Handy clip-on holder for cuttlebone and mineral blocks. Keeps supplements secure inside the cage without falling. Essential for maintaining healthy beaks and supplying calcium to pet birds.

name: Bird Accessory Starter Kit – Blue
description: Complete starter kit for new bird owners in vibrant blue. Includes a water dish, seed feeder, perch clip, and a small hanging toy. Everything needed to set up a welcoming cage environment.

name: Decorative Bird Bath & Feeder – Outdoor
description: Attractive outdoor bird bath and feeding tray combination. Shallow basin design is ideal for small birds to drink and bathe. Weather-resistant construction suitable for balconies and gardens.

name: Pedigree Adult Dry Dog Food – Chicken & Rice
description: Pedigree Adult Dry Dog Food with real chicken and rice delivers 100% complete and balanced daily nutrition. Supports strong muscles, healthy digestion, and a shiny coat. Available in a resealable bag to keep it fresh.

name: Pedigree Puppy Wet Dog Food – Chicken in Gravy
description: Soft and tender chicken chunks in rich gravy specially designed for growing puppies. Enriched with DHA for brain development and calcium for strong bones. Ideal as a complete meal or a topping on dry kibble.

name: Pedigree DentaStix – Daily Dental Chews
description: X-shaped DentaStix chews clean hard-to-reach areas and reduce tartar build-up by up to 80%. A delicious treat your dog will love every day. Suitable for medium to large breeds. Pack of 7 sticks.

name: Cat Food
description: Whiskas tuna in jelly pouches are packed with flavour and complete nutrition for adult cats. Made with real tuna, gently cooked to preserve taste and aroma. Supports urinary health and a shiny coat.

name: Whiskas Kitten Dry Food – Milk & Chicken
description: Specially formulated dry food for kittens up to 12 months. Contains DHA for brain and eye development, calcium for growing bones, and real chicken for lean protein. Crunchy kibble helps maintain early dental health.

name: Royal Canin Persian Adult Cat Dry Food
description: Breed-specific nutrition tailored for Persian cats aged 1 year and above. Unique almond-shaped kibble makes it easy for flat-faced Persians to pick up and chew. Supports a long, silky coat and digestive health.

name: Royal Canin Medium Breed Adult Dog Food – 4kg
description: Scientifically formulated for medium-breed dogs aged 12 months to 7 years. Supports optimal weight, healthy bones, and a strong immune system. Contains high-quality proteins and a precise blend of vitamins and minerals.

name: Reflex Adult Cat Dry Food – Chicken 1.5kg
description: Reflex Adult Cat Food with real chicken provides complete balanced nutrition for adult cats. Enriched with taurine for heart and eye health, plus omega fatty acids for a glossy coat. Turkish-made quality at an affordable price.

name: Reflex Kitten Dry Food – Lamb & Rice 1.5kg
description: High-energy kitten formula with tender lamb and easily digestible rice. Supports healthy growth, strong immunity, and developing eyesight. Suitable for kittens from 2 months up to 12 months of age.

name: Budgie & Parakeet Mixed Seed Food – 500g
description: Nutritionally balanced seed mix for budgies, parakeets, and finches. Contains millet, canary seed, oats, and dried vegetables. High in energy and natural vitamins to keep small birds active and healthy all day.

name: Premium Parrot & Cockatiel Seed Mix – 1kg
description: A rich blend of sunflower seeds, peanuts, safflower, and dried fruit specifically crafted for medium to large parrots and cockatiels. Promotes feather health and natural foraging behaviour. Resealable zipper bag.

name: Pigeon Feed – High Energy Grain Mix 1kg
description: Specially blended grain mix for racing and homing pigeons. Contains corn, wheat, peas, and barley for maximum energy and endurance. Supports muscle recovery and healthy plumage. Suitable for all pigeon breeds.

name: Tropical Fish Flake Food – 100g
description: Premium multi-ingredient fish flake food for tropical and community fish. Enhances natural colour, promotes growth, and boosts immunity. Slow-sinking flakes minimise water clouding. Suitable for goldfish, guppies, and tetras.

name: Hikari Goldfish Pellet Food – 300g
description: Hikari's scientifically formulated pellets designed specifically for goldfish. Floating micro-pellets are easy to eat without causing digestive issues. Enriched with vitamins C and E to support vibrant colour and immune health.

name: Wanda Cattle & Livestock Feed – 10kg Bag
description: Wanda by Hi-Tech is Pakistan's trusted name in premium cattle and livestock feed. Formulated with high-quality grains, minerals, and protein concentrates to maximise milk yield and overall animal health. Suitable for cows, goats, and buffalo.

name: Pedigree Dog Treat – Grilled Liver Biscuits 500g
description: Oven-baked biscuits with real grilled liver flavour that dogs absolutely love. A wholesome treat enriched with vitamins and minerals. Low in fat and suitable as a daily reward or training treat for adult dogs.
